SYNTHETIC A101 ENGINEERING CASE. These proteins, assays and functions are invented.
RefA and RefB belong to HydrolaseFamily.
Search sequence RefA is the sequence of assayed protein ConstructA.
Search sequence RefB is the sequence of assayed protein ConstructB.
Assays used buffer pH 7 at 25 C.
ConstructA catalyzed AlphaReaction with AlphaSubstrate. ConstructB catalyzed BetaReaction with BetaSubstrate.
ConstructA has histidine at residue 61, using one-based protein coordinates. Its H61Q mutant lost AlphaReaction activity while retaining the measured folded state under these assay conditions.
ConstructB has glutamine at residue 61. This observation alone does not establish that glutamine is necessary or sufficient for BetaReaction.
Neither the supplied target nor its physiological role was measured.
